citationText: 9. The design was covered by Brit. Pat. 15732/1905, but the lens construction given in that patent was clearly incorrect as the thicknesses were too small to permit the claimed f/8 aperture. A later specification for an f/10 design was given in Merté W. Richter R. Rohr M. V. , Das photographische Objektiv , p. 339 , example 2. Springer , Wien , 1932 .
